context:
You asked, 15:02 CDT: is tokens.md for Banchi or claude-settings? claude-settings: docs/design/tokens.md, the house style for every app, says 'Corner radius is 8 px'. Your pick a bends it for Banchi only; other apps stay at 8.

Goal: the Banchi Shelf looks right and matches your house style. Problem: the redraw rounds the floating dock 20 and its buttons 14 (the phone frame is 28), while tokens.md says every corner is 8; only you can bend or change the house rule. Based on: the v3 mockup's own CSS (read); tokens.md 'Corner radius is 8 px' (read); design review round 3 PASS (lane report).

designs.label: A: dock 20, List button 14 (C looks the same)
B: dock and List button at 8

options.gain: The floating dock reads like iOS glass.
options.how: Dock 20, buttons 14, cards 8, trays 4, in Banchi only.
options.label: Keep the mockup's corners
options.lose: Banchi departs from tokens.md; other apps stay at 8. Goes against your uniform ruling (t18).

options.gain: One rule in every app, no change to tokens.md.
options.how: The builder draws the dock and buttons at 8.
options.label: Everything at 8, per tokens.md
options.lose: The floating dock and big button look boxier than iOS's own glass.

options.gain: The dock keeps its look, written once for every app.
options.how: Looks exactly like A's picture. A lane writes 8 for cards, 14 for controls, 20 for floating bars into tokens.md, for every app.
options.label: Add a small scale to tokens.md
options.lose: Widens a shared token that every repo's screens then follow. Goes against your uniform ruling (t18).

ref: d4 v3 Shelf redraw, roadmap branch designs/d4-banchi-phone-v3 (PR #866, 4e27249c), notes item 15; docs/design/tokens.md (corner radius 8)
title: Banchi Shelf: which corner roundness?
why: It keeps one corner rule in every app, as your uniform ruling (t18) asks; the dock looks a little boxier.
